SELECT d.* FROM dramas d JOIN reactions r ON r.target_id = d.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.target_type = 'drama' AND r.kind = 'favorite' AND d.status = 'published' ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
